jobs.description:
Trail Drive Management Corp is seeking a full-time 24/7 Security Officer to protect our Fort Worth venues. This on-site role includes patrols, access control, incident reporting, and coordination with the Security Supervisor.

The ideal candidate has 3+ years in security or related fields, valid Texas driver’s license, and the ability to obtain a Texas Guard Card; bilingual English/Spanish is a plus. CPR/first aid skills are expected.

jobs.title: Stadium Event Security Specialist (Evenings/Weekends)
jobs.description:
BEST Crowd Management is seeking an Event Security Officer for AT&T Stadium in Arlington, TX. This part-time role requires strong observational and communication skills, combined with a commitment to safety and customer service.

Responsibilities include patrolling, monitoring access points, and responding to incidents.

Candidates should be at least 18 years old, have a high school diploma, and possess physical fitness abilities. Opportunities for career growth and flexible scheduling are available.
